summary: N02 (v4 follow-up): typed secret validation after decoding. resolveSecret now runs validateFieldValue(descriptor, decoded) before returning, so a JSON object for a string field is INVALID instead of becoming "[object Object]"; env values are validated after decoding too. providers/platform.inboundSecrets resolves via the declared inbound secret descriptor and rejects any non-string value (no String() coercion). accounts writes reject a literal whose decoded type does not match the field. The importer now stores literals JSON-encoded (02-DATA), which is what surfaced the previous raw-string path. Verification: npm run check passes (75 source files); npm test 404 pass / 0 fail (new N02 cases in test/unit/secrets.test.mjs; import integration suite green again).
